name: Garni Zipferkeller
beschreibung:
Conveniently located near the historic center of Kufstein, the traditional Zipferkeller welcomes visitors with comfortable rooms and genuine Tyrolean charm. It is an excellent choice for cultural outings and city breaks.

The celebrated Kufstein Fortress, picturesque Roemerhofgasse, and the Inn promenade are just a short walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: Garni Zipferkeller in Kufstein provides traditional hospitality in the heart of the historic fortress city.
